subject: Re: Quick qualification before demo — concurrency & timeline
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@crafthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick qualification before demo — concurrency & timeline

Hi Samira —

Thanks for signing up with Redwood and for the quick call request. Before we lock in a demo slot I usually run a 5–7 question check to make the session concrete for your team and to ensure we bring the right engineer. Could you share short answers to the items below? A sentence or two each is perfect.

1) Primary use case: generation (chat/assist), embeddings (semantic search/vector DB), reranking, or a mix?
2) Estimated peak concurrency (QPS) and typical daily active users — both ballpark numbers are fine.
3) Average prompt/response size (tokens or characters) and any long-form outputs we should expect.
4) Do you plan to index fingerprints/embeddings up front (batch) or stream users’ content into the index? Approx docs and vector count.
5) Timeline: POC target date and expected production date (months).
6) Compliance/region needs we should be aware of (SOC 2, data residency, encryption keys, etc.).

I attached our latest pricing sheet for reference (redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.pdf). Monica (solutions) and Ben (SDR) are on copy — Monica can run the technical pre-call if you want a deep dive into batching/throughput.

If it helps, we can do a two-part meeting: a 20-min infra check (technical) then a 30-min product demo. Proposed windows next week: Tue 08/17 09:00–11:30 PDT or Thu 08/19 08:30–12:00 PDT. Tell us what works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Samira Khan <samira@crafthouse.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <psingh@crafthouse.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick qualification before demo — concurrency & timeline

Hi Laura —

Thanks — happy to answer. Short version below; I attached a small traffic CSV (traffic-matrix-0601.csv) so you can see our shape.

1) Use case: Primarily embeddings for semantic search across product docs and customer conversations; secondary use-case is short LLM summaries and entity extraction.
2) Peak concurrency: planning for 50–75 QPS at peak, typical DAU 12k–20k depending on campaigns.
3) Average size: ~120 tokens request + ~80 tokens response for search augmentation; summaries can be up to 800–1,200 tokens but are less frequent (~5% of calls).
4) Indexing: batch initial ingest (~10M docs), then streaming updates for recent content. We expect ~10M vectors at POC ramp.
5) Timeline: target POC in ~6 weeks; aim for production in 4 months with a staged rollout.
6) Compliance: SOC 2 is required; prefer US data residency and support for customer-managed keys down the line.

We can do Tue 08/17 morning PST — Priya and I prefer 10:00–11:00 if that works.

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of ML Platform, Crafthouse AI
samira@crafthouse.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@crafthouse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick qualification before demo — concurrency & timeline

Thanks Samira — that’s super helpful.

Monica, I’m looping you in to run the technical pre-call and to prepare the demo to focus on embeddings indexing strategies, batching behavior, and long-form summary cost controls. Can you propose a short pre-call agenda and confirm whether the traffic CSV is sufficient for a basic throughput estimate?

Proposed plan:
- 20 min technical pre-call (review traffic + indexing approach + quick perf estimate)
- 30 min product demo (end-to-end: ingest -> index -> query -> summary flow; include quantization/packing recommendations)

Samira, I’ll send a calendar invite once Monica confirms the timeslot. If 10:00–11:00 PDT Tue 08/17 works we’ll lock it.

—Laura

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@crafthouse.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick qualification before demo — concurrency & timeline

Hi Samira / Laura —

Thanks for the context — the CSV and the bullets are perfect. I’ll cover:
- Indexing strategy (batch vs streaming) and expected vector store sizing for 10M vectors
- Batching & KV-cache behavior to meet the 50–75 QPS target and latency SLOs
- Cost levers (quantization, suffix/prefix caching, request shaping) for long summaries
- Quick checklist for SOC 2 and KMS integration points

Agenda for the pre-call (20 min):
1) Quick architecture + dataset sanity-check (5 min)
2) Throughput estimate & critical knobs (10 min)
3) Open questions & next steps (5 min)

I can do Tue 08/17 at 10:00 PDT for the pre-call. After that we’ll run the 30-min demo (no more than 45 total). I’ll bring a short slide with a sample throughput table and two configuration recommendations.

I’ve attached our standard SOW template for reference (sow-template.docx) and will include a short perf-estimate memo after the pre-call.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
